name: When is the best time to purchase a new development condo?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to purchase a new development condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 'best' time to purchase a new development condo often depends on your priorities. Buying during the pre-construction phase typically offers the lowest prices, the widest selection of units, and more customization options. However, it also involves a longer waiting period for completion. Purchasing closer to completion might mean higher prices but a shorter wait time and the ability to see a finished product. Kelby Contreras guides clients through these tradeoffs, helping them decide based on their investment goals and lifestyle needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time to buy a new development condo depends on whether you prioritize lower prices and customization (pre-construction) or a shorter wait (closer to completion).
